topic_en: Compute the Laplace transform of e to the a t times sine of b t. First, recall that the Laplace transform of sine of b t is b over s squared plus b squared. Second, apply the first shifting theorem, which states multiplying by e to the a t in the time domain shifts s to s minus a in the frequency domain. Third, substitute s with s minus a in the original transform to get b over s minus a squared plus b squared. Fourth, state the final answer L of e to the a t times sine of b t equals b over the quantity s minus a squared plus b squared. Show the formula at each step using MathTex.

from manim import *


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ---------- Title ----------
        title = Text("Laplace Transform of  e^{at} sin(bt)", font_size=40, color=YELLOW)
        underline = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=YELLOW).set_width(title.width + 0.5)
        underline.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.15)
        self.play(Write(title), GrowFromCenter(underline))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(
            title.animate.scale(0.7).to_edge(UP),
            FadeOut(underline),
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ---------- Step 1 ----------
        step1_label = Text("Step 1:  Laplace transform of sin(bt)", font_size=28, color=BLUE)
        step1_label.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
